edit.ability:
(2GCD)(OYT) summon a Silithid on any slot.
May donate 8 SP, 8 points, and 8 bricks total to the war effort over the course of the game to open the gates, summoning one Anubisath Guardian on every friendly slot and replacing this item with “The Temple of Ahn'Qiraj”.
